instruction: A candid documentary wide shot from a high angle in an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet. On the left, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing the right, watching the action. On the right, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) leans his upper body back, kicking his right leg horizontally towards her torso. The room is brightly lit by overhead fluorescent lights, showing white walls, a ceiling projector, and studio equipment in the background, creating a clean, neutral atmosphere.
